propositions: Assignee resolver is currently injected as an attribute on the outbound mapper, discovered via getattr with silent fallback, making it invisible to type checkers and prone to silent degradation when injection fails
The attribute injection hides a real bug where Data Center adapter's getattr would always fail, leaving entire authoritative branches dead code
Resolver must be threaded explicitly through OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee as a keyword parameter in the neutral port, Cloud backend, and DC backend to establish it as a declared contract

DC backend has two resolver sources with different lifecycles (constructor-bound client resolver vs per-issue core resolver) that must coexist with explicit precedence (core wins, constructor is fallback)
All four sites of attribute assignment/discovery and getattr calls must be eliminated, along with their type: ignore directives, without changing any observable resolution outcomes
